text:
Five years after the trade that sent him from Buffalo to Vegas, Jack Eichel is still the engine of the Golden Knights. He has 24 points in 19 games, he drives five-on-five play (Vegas takes 57.7% of the expected goals with him on), and he capped a week by scoring in Buffalo on Nov. 8, the building where his best points-per-game rate comes against.

The caution is on the ice around him, not in his own game. Vegas has scored 10.6 more goals than its chances deserve with Eichel out there, the biggest piece of his total, and his last ten games produced 8 points when we'd expect about 11.5. So the season line is a little flattering while the recent form is a little unlucky, which roughly cancels out.

Evolving-Hockey had him sixth among forwards in wins above replacement last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking ranks him a 98th-percentile setup man. That's the player. Our projection puts him around 95 points; expect the goals for and against with him on to meet in the middle.
headline: Eichel's points are ahead of his process
